```{r}
resistance_files <- list.files(
    pattern="\\.resistance\\.tsv$"
)

resistance_df <- resistance_files |>
    purrr::map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(
            .x,
            col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
        ) |>
        mutate(
            Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
            )
        )
    )


if(nrow(resistance_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  colnames(resistance_df) <- gsub("ganciclovir", "Ganciclovir", colnames(resistance_df))
  colnames(resistance_df) <- gsub("foscarnet", "Foscarnet", colnames(resistance_df))
  colnames(resistance_df) <- gsub("cidofovir", "Cidofovir", colnames(resistance_df))
  colnames(resistance_df) <- gsub("maribavir", "Maribavir", colnames(resistance_df))
  colnames(resistance_df) <- gsub("letermovir", "Letermovir", colnames(resistance_df))
  condensed_df <- resistance_df |> 
    mutate(
      across(
        ends_with("EC50_ratio"),
        as.character
      )
    ) |> 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = matches("(_EC50_ratio|_resistance)$"),
      names_to = c("Drug", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "(.*)_(EC50_ratio|resistance)"
    ) |>
    filter(!(is.na(EC50_ratio) & is.na(resistance)))

  parse_ec50 <- function(x) {

    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0)
      return(numeric())

    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]

    out <- numeric()

    for (v in x) {

      v_lower <- tolower(v)

      if (v_lower == "susceptible")
        next

      if (v_lower %in% c("resistance", "resistant"))
        next

      # Remove >, >=, <, <=
      v <- gsub("^[<>]=?", "", v)

      # Split values like 3.6/3.4 or 5.6\4.7
      vals <- unlist(strsplit(v, "[/\\\\]"))

      nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))

      out <- c(out, nums[!is.na(nums)])
    }

    out
  }

  format_range <- function(x, digits = 1) {

    # If every non-NA value is "Susceptible"
    txt <- trimws(as.character(x))
    txt <- txt[!is.na(txt)]

    if (length(txt) > 0 &&
        all(tolower(txt) == "susceptible")) {
      return("Susceptible")
    }

    nums <- sort(parse_ec50(x))

    if (length(nums) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    if (min(nums) == max(nums))
      return(format(round(min(nums), digits), trim = TRUE))

    sprintf(
      "%s–%s",
      format(round(min(nums), digits), trim = TRUE),
      format(round(max(nums), digits), trim = TRUE)
    )
  }

  levels <- c("Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High")

  format_level <- function(x){

    x <- factor(na.omit(x), levels = levels, ordered = TRUE)

    if(length(x) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    lo <- min(x)
    hi <- max(x)

    if(lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  get_resistance_level <- function(x) {

    case_when(
      is.na(x) ~ "Unknown",
      x < 2 ~ "Susceptible",
      x < 5 ~ "Low",
      x < 15 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "High"
    )
  }

  summarise_resistance <- function(x) {

    txt <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
    txt <- txt[!is.na(txt)]

    if (length(txt) > 0) {

      if (all(txt == "susceptible"))
        return("Susceptible")

      if (all(txt %in% c("resistance", "resistant")))
        return("Unknown")
    }

    nums <- sort(parse_ec50(x))

    # No numeric values
    if (length(nums) == 0)
      return("Unknown")

    levs <- factor(
      get_resistance_level(nums),
      levels = c("Unknown", "Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )

    lo <- min(levs)
    hi <- max(levs)

    if (lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  summary_df <- condensed_df |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    summarise(
      `EC50 ratio` = format_range(EC50_ratio),
      `Level of resistance` = summarise_resistance(EC50_ratio),
      Reference = paste0("[@", unique(BIBTEXKEY), "]", collapse = "; "),#paste(unique(Reference), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  level_order <- c(
    "Unknown",
    "Susceptible",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High"
  )

  highest_level <- function(x) {

    if (is.na(x) || x == "")
      return("Unknown")

    # Split ranges like "Low–Medium"
    levs <- unlist(strsplit(x, "–"))

    levs <- factor(levs,
                  levels = level_order,
                  ordered = TRUE)

    as.character(max(levs))
  }

  summary_table <- summary_df

  summary_table$Drug <- factor(
    summary_table$Drug,
    levels = c(
      "Ganciclovir",
      "Foscarnet",
      "Cidofovir",
      "Maribavir",
      "Letermovir"
    )
  )

  summary_table <-
    summary_table |>
    mutate(Resistance = vapply(`Level of resistance`, highest_level, character(1))) |>
    select(Gene, Mutation, Drug, Resistance) |>
    distinct() |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Drug,
      values_from = Resistance,
      names_expand = TRUE,
      values_fill = "Unknown"
    ) |>
    select(
      Gene,
      Mutation,
      Ganciclovir,
      Foscarnet,
      Cidofovir,
      Maribavir,
      Letermovir
    )

  legend <- HTML(
    paste(
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#A9A9A9;border:1px solid black;'></span> Unknown (not found in database)",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#00FF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Susceptible (< 2 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFFF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Low (>= 2 & < 5 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFA500;border:1px solid black;'></span> Medium (>= 5 & < 15 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FF0000;border:1px solid black;'></span> High (>= 15 EC50 ratio)"
      )
    )

  tbl <- gt(summary_table)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),

      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(

      )
    ) |>

      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(

      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,

      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(

    ) |> tab_source_note(source_note = legend)

}
```
